purpose: Track retroactive application of decision criteria to existing UNTOLD specifications. Append a review entry whenever a criterion is added, materially changed, or explicitly re-applied to existing content.

reviewStates.complete: All identified matching current pages were reviewed for this criterion revision.
reviewStates.partial: Some matching pages remain unreviewed; do not claim the criterion has been fully propagated.
reviewStates.blocked: A conflict requires a design decision before propagation can finish.

reviews.reason: Governance registry bootstrap and maintenance-layer deduplication
exceptions: AGENTS.md remains unchanged; existing bootstrap already routes agents through README.md, ai-manifest.json and pages/chatgpt-guide.md, which now contain the governance route.
reviews.notes: Existing design and naming criteria were registered without changing their substantive rule text. The maintenance layer was deduplicated so confirmed game facts remain in topical canonical pages. No substantive game-design decision was changed by this review.

reviews.reason: Add a point-first specified-card production criterion while preserving all already confirmed card content
exceptions: Confirmed, D4-confirmed, individual-canonical, regional-bundle-canonical, and otherwise already fixed card fields were not rewritten.
The five existing unintegrated decisions in decision-inbox.md were left intact and were not reinterpreted by this criterion.
Card-template, design-philosophy, naming-guidelines, ChatGPT-guide, and existing regional-bundle pages were checked for compatibility but required no text changes.
reviews.notes: The only direct process conflict was the region-first simultaneous-design step in card-roster. It was replaced with point generation/fixation first, then classification/region allocation, acquisition design, and selective connection. Existing ratios, regional counts, information networks, foreshadowing, progression, dependencies, and person-role allocations remain unchanged. Intentional foreshadowing still follows design-philosophy/foreshadowing-ledger; an independent card is not automatically a clue.
